SELECT kb.id, kb.user_id, kb.name, kb.cover, kb.description, kb.visibility, kb.created_at, kb.updated_at FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_base_favorite GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) fav ON fav.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
AND (kb.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR kb.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
ORDER BY COALESCE(fav.cnt, 0) DESC
